For instance, do you remember how long it has been since you moved into your new home? How many days until your best friend's birthday? Do you know which day you'll celebrate your 10,000th day on Earth?

That's why KeyDays was developed—to help me record, track, and remind me of celebrating important days like birthdays of loved ones, anniversaries, exam dates, and more. 

KeyDays is lightweight, simple, and compact. No cluttered features, no ads, just your important days.
